verdict.rationale: Text was extracted verbatim from several Corporations Canada guidance pages on ised-isde.canada.ca (how-incorporate, fees and processing times, annual return, home). That suggests the public reading surface serves readable server-rendered content, but no probe of those pages records the request method, status code, user agent, or the absence of a bot wall or CAPTCHA. The only probe hit open.canada.ca's CKAN API, a different host-platform surface, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a direct keyless probe of the ised-isde.canada.ca guidance pages with an identified user agent, recorded HTTP 200 with substantive HTML, and explicit confirmation of no JS-only shell, bot wall or CAPTCHA.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
